cancellation.introText: This Cancellation Policy sets out the terms that apply to cancellations, date changes, and refunds for hot air balloon flights with Flying Pictures México.
cancellation.customerIntro: If you need to cancel your reservation:
cancellation.refund48: 24-72 hours in advance: 50% refund or one complimentary date change.
cancellation.refund24: Less than 24 hours in advance: No refund. Date changes are subject to availability.
cancellation.customerNote: All cancellations must be requested in writing by email. Refund processing takes 5 to 10 business days.
cancellation.noshowText: Failure to arrive at the confirmed time and meeting point results in forfeiture of the payment, with no refund or date change.
cancellation.changesIntro: The following conditions apply to date changes:
cancellation.change72: More than 72 hours in advance: One complimentary change, subject to availability.
cancellation.change48: 24-72 hours in advance: One complimentary change; additional changes may incur a 25% fee.
cancellation.change24: Less than 24 hours in advance: Change subject to availability and a 50% fee.
cancellation.changesNote: Requests must be made at least 4 hours before the scheduled flight.
cancellation.weatherIntro: If we cancel because conditions are unsafe, you may choose:
cancellation.weatherNote: The final weather-related cancellation decision belongs to the certified pilot in command.
cancellation.healthIntro: If you cannot fly for medical reasons:
cancellation.healthWithCert: With a valid medical certificate: Full refund or complimentary date change.
cancellation.healthWithoutCert: Without a medical certificate: The standard cancellation policy applies.
cancellation.healthNote: The certificate must be issued by an authorised medical professional.
cancellation.process2: Include your booking number and reason for the request.
cancellation.process6: Refunds are issued to the original payment method.
cancellation.groupsText: Special conditions may apply to bookings for groups of 8 or more passengers. The applicable terms will be provided with the group quote.
cancellation.insuranceText: You may wish to purchase independent travel insurance that covers cancellations and interruptions.
cancellation.exceptionsText: Flying Pictures México may evaluate exceptional circumstances individually.

privacy.introText: Flying Pictures México is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information when you visit our website or use our hot air balloon flight services.
privacy.dataIntro: We may collect the following types of information:
privacy.personalInfo: Personal information: Name, email address, phone number, address, and payment details provided during booking.
privacy.identificationInfo: Identification information: Passport, INE, or another official ID used to verify identity.
privacy.healthInfo: Health information: Weight, relevant medical conditions, and physical restrictions needed for flight safety.
privacy.technicalInfo: Technical information: IP address, browser type, operating system, and website usage data.
privacy.photosVideos: Photos and videos: Images captured during your flight experience with your consent.
privacy.usageIntro: We use your information for the following purposes:
privacy.useProcess: To process and manage your flight reservations
privacy.useCommunicate: To send confirmations, reminders, and relevant operational information
privacy.useSafety: To ensure your safety during the flight experience
privacy.useImprove: To improve our services and user experience
privacy.useLegal: To comply with legal and regulatory obligations
privacy.useMarketing: To send promotional communications (with your consent)
privacy.usePayment: To process payments and prevent fraud
privacy.protectionText: We use technical, administrative, and physical safeguards intended to protect personal information from unauthorised access, loss, alteration, or disclosure. These include restricted access controls and security procedures appropriate to our operation.
privacy.cookiesText: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve the experience and analyse website traffic. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.sharingIntro: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share your data with:
privacy.sharingProviders: Service providers: Payment processors, communications services, and technology infrastructure providers.
privacy.sharingAuthorities: Regulatory authorities: When required by law, including civil aviation or public safety authorities.
privacy.sharingPartners: Business partners: Hotels, restaurants, and transportation providers involved in your selected experience, when necessary or with your consent.
privacy.rightsIntro: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
privacy.rightDelete: Request deletion of your personal data
privacy.rightObject: Object to or restrict data processing
privacy.rightWithdraw: Withdraw your consent at any time
privacy.retentionText: We retain personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this notice, unless a longer period is required or permitted by law. Booking records may be retained for safety and compliance purposes.
privacy.minorsText: Bookings must be made by an adult. When a minor travels, their personal information must be provided by a parent or legal guardian and is used only as necessary to manage the booking and flight safely.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Notice periodically. Material changes will be communicated by publishing the updated notice and revision date on this page.

terms.introText: Welcome to Flying Pictures México. These Terms and Conditions govern the use of our hot air balloon flight services and website. By booking, participating in a flight, or using the website, you agree to these terms.
terms.servicesIntro: Flying Pictures México offers hot air balloon flight experiences over the Teotihuacán area. Our services include:
terms.serviceExtras: Additional services such as transportation and breakfast
terms.bookingIntro: To book a flight, you must:
terms.booking1: Provide accurate and up-to-date personal information, including valid identification.
terms.booking2: Provide accurate health and weight information relevant to safe operation.
terms.booking3: Complete the full payment or required deposit for the selected booking.
terms.booking4: Confirm the booking within the period specified during purchase.
terms.bookingNote: Confirmation is subject to availability and suitable weather conditions.
terms.pricingIntro: Prices are displayed in Mexican pesos (MXN). Inclusions depend on the selected experience and may include:
terms.priceInclude1: A certified hot air balloon flight
terms.priceInclude4: A sparkling toast or non-alcoholic alternative
terms.priceNote: Transportation, meals, tours, and other extras are included only when listed in the selected package.
terms.requirementsIntro: To take part in a flight, passengers must meet the following requirements:
terms.reqAge: Age: Minimum 4 years old. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
terms.reqWeight: Weight: Maximum 120 kg (265 lb) per passenger. Accurate weight information is required for flight planning.
terms.reqHealth: Health: Passengers must disclose relevant conditions. Pregnant guests cannot fly.
terms.reqDocs: Documentation: A current official photo ID may be required at check-in.
terms.safetyText: Safety is our highest priority. Pilots are certified by the civil aviation authority and aircraft are inspected regularly. The pilot in command has final authority over all safety-related decisions.
terms.weatherText: Flights depend on weather conditions. We operate only when the pilot determines conditions are safe. If conditions are unsuitable, the flight will be rescheduled or refunded according to the Cancellation Policy.
terms.liabilityText: Flying Pictures México operates in accordance with applicable aviation regulations. Liability is limited as permitted by law and by the applicable insurance policy. We are not responsible for delays, cancellations, or losses outside our reasonable control.
terms.ipText: Website content, including text, images, logos, and design, belongs to Flying Pictures México or is used under licence. Unauthorised use is prohibited.
terms.mediaText: Photos or videos intended for promotional use require consent. You may decline or withdraw that consent by notifying our team, subject to applicable law.
terms.modificationsText: We may update these terms. Changes take effect when published on this page and do not retroactively alter confirmed booking terms unless required by law.
terms.lawText: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Mexican States. Disputes will be submitted to the competent courts of the State of Mexico, unless applicable consumer law provides otherwise.
terms.resp3: Not be under the influence of alcohol or controlled substances
terms.resp5: Accept responsibility for damage caused by personal negligence
terms.resp6: Arrive on time at the confirmed meeting point
